Author: Glamour Pact contributors
Name: Glamour Pact
Punchline: Dom-controlled looks, local Synced Mods and opt-in strict controls.
Description: A compact Dom/Sub wardrobe companion. Lock Glamourer equipment, create local Penumbra looks from already-resolved sync resources, and optionally enable experimental exact-Dom follow or pose locks. Optional Dom control of GPact Offline; disabling Glamour Pact in Dalamud always releases locally.
Changelog: Reduces idle server traffic: hidden unpaired clients and Doms with only offline peers refresh presence every 30 seconds; hidden Dom telemetry slows while active controls and commands stay responsive. Identical Sub status uploads are deduplicated without changing the 15-second heartbeat. Opening controls refreshes immediately. Same-world Offline-lock renewal, expiry, permissions and plugin-disable escape remain unchanged. The service also receives an index-only D1 optimization with no protocol change.
